chapters.title: A business approval must survive a worker failure
Submit a supplier through the authenticated control plane
The case persists and enters a human approval wait
Policy evidence informs the decision; the model has no approval authority
Temporal preserves the case while it waits for an authorized human
A versioned human approval authorizes the business action
Business effects are committed while Temporal is still running
SIGKILL is observed after the effects commit, before acknowledgement
Durable orchestration retains the activity during worker interruption
A replacement worker completes recovery with one of each effect
Temporal history shows the redelivered decision activity and completion
Operational metrics corroborate redelivery and duplicate prevention
Final case evidence: one approval, one supplier record, one notification
Verified redelivery without duplicate business effects
